about: layoutfit.js results on library pages with odd whitespace (U+FEFF, U+001C to U+001F, U+0085 and others), an empty {} fill, numeric run text and an empty [] line: places where Python and JS read values differently. Made from layoutfit.js with the one-row-one-size rule (lavender fc/layoutfit-row-sizes, 2bad4e9c, wrap and line rules); each case parted the first port (7fc9f6f) from the JS. Re-made at lavender fc/layoutfit-wrap-lines 32919ee8 (the line rule lowers a raise only; holds kept; labels outside the margin).
